description:
The companion population (baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv) has ZERO rows for
perl's t/lib/ directory -- 0 of 256 snapshot rows.  s495 ran two of them
because the s492c brief asked for the lib/ files that use POSIX / File::Spec /
File::Temp / Carp:

  lib/deprecate.t   perl 10/0   PCL 4/6    (IDENTICAL on a 5ce155cb extraction)
  lib/no_load.t     perl  2/0   PCL 2/0    OK

The six failing rows are "archlibexp - message", "archlibexp - location",
"privlibexp - message", "privlibexp - location" and the two "use if - message"
rows: deprecate.pm warns that a module has moved, and the test matches the
warning TEXT and the "at FILE line N" location.  That is the warn-location /
warnings-gated-diagnostic family (#1361, #221), not a deprecate.pm bug.

NOT SPLICED into the baselines on purpose: t/lib is not in the companion's
standing population, so blessing rows for it would make every later `--all`
run report them LOST.  If t/lib is ever added to the scan, these two files are
its first two measurements, taken at s495 on both the base and the tree.
subject: FIRST MEASUREMENT: lib/deprecate.t is 4/10 under PCL (the deprecation warning's message and location)
